These synthetic 32 × 16 pixel images contain a solid RGBA color (80, 20, 150, 0.5); JPEG has no alpha channel. They were generated once with the pre-existing Sharp 0.35.5 installation using `sharp({ create: { width: 32, height: 16, channels: 4, background: { r: 80, g: 20, b: 150, alpha: 0.5 } } }).toFormat(format)` for PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP. They contain no user data or third-party artwork. Tests read the fixed bytes without requiring an image processing package. Actual browser decoding is covered separately by the packaged application smoke test.
